title: 2chat
description: Adds a fully configureable second readonly "chat"
body:
This mod adds a fully configureable second "chat" window.
Players cant interact with the chat like normal, it is purely readonly.

By using the command 
`
twochat <Selector> <Text>
`
you can add a message to the chat similar to how tellraw works.

---

Primairly made for adventuremap makers and similar.
